result.stdout:
new-sdd-workspace — scaffold an FS.GG workspace (SDD + Rendering + optional 
Governance)

Usage
  new-sdd-workspace <target-dir> <product-name> [options]
  (from a checkout: dotnet run --project scripts/NewSddWorkspace -- <target-dir>
<product-name>)

Options
  --profile <name>   render profile (default: game = provider default)
                    game, app, headless-scene, governed, sample-pack
  --ref <git-ref>    FS.GG.Templates ref for the descriptor (default: main = 
newest)
  --board <owner/title>  coordination board to wire the workspace to (default: 
FS-GG/Coordination)
  --repo <owner/repo>    this workspace's own repo (its board identity + 
chore-lock basis)
  --chore-locks <refs>   FSGG_COORD_CHORE_LOCKS for a non-FS-GG board 
(owner/repo#n,… — comma-separated)
  --no-coordination  skip wiring the workspace to a coordination board (no kit, 
no env)
  --pinned           skip the pre-scaffold fsgg-sdd self-update (scaffold with 
the installed CLI)
                    default: self-update to the newest coherent set first; pair 
--pinned with --ref <tag> for a reproducible scaffold
  --upgrade          also run `fsgg-sdd upgrade` after scaffolding (reconcile an
existing project)
  --no-governance    skip the governance overlay

Run with no arguments on an interactive terminal to build the invocation with 
prompts.
